meta.name: tiktok-script-writer
meta.description: Write short-form video scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts that promote affiliate products with strong hooks, demos, and CTAs. Use this skill when the user asks about TikTok scripts, Reels scripts, Shorts scripts, short-form video for affiliate marketing, or says "write a TikTok for X", "script a Reel promoting X", "YouTube Shorts script affiliate", "60-second video script", "hook for TikTok affiliate", "write a video promoting X", "TikTok script that converts", "short video script for product review", "viral TikTok affiliate script", "how to promote X on TikTok".
